main_text.p: ciosis crepundiis, quibus teneros Ethnicos fascinant, ne unquam queant pervenire ad perfectam staturam ætatis Christi: retrahamus animos eorum, ab hisce inferioribus, ut in cœlis Spiritu conversentur, ubi Christus est, sedens ad dexteram Patris. Coloss. 3. 16. Inhabitet sermo Christi ut monet Apostolus in ipsis opulenter, cum omni sapientia & prudentia spirituali; hujus instructi doctrina, doceant & commoneant se invicem: psalmis & laudibus & cantionibus spiritualibus, cum gratia in corde suo Domino canentes. Discant, quomodo spiritu & veritate Deus colendus sit, nec superstitiosis, certoque numero appensis precibus assuescant, aut reliquiarum & prophanis ritibus consecratarum rerum, mendaci sanctimoniæ confidant, sed omnia in syncero Dei timore posita norint, illum in feruidas preces erumpentem, quovis amuleto potentiorem credant: Ne dubitemus, confirmare illos & instruere, ut plena cum certitudine fidei invocent Deum in die necessitatis, certi se recepturos, quicquid in nomine Christi, secundum voluntatem ejus petieri nt: vigilabit enim Dominus ad petitiones illorum, & respondebit antequam clamarint, propter gloriam Nominis sui & Vncti sui. Nam

page.notes: The marginal note "Coloss. 3. 16." is printed beside the first line, right margin. Long s rendered as s throughout. "petieri nt" and "fidei invocent" are printed with the spacing shown. The word after "unquam" in line 2 and the letters of "posita" are slightly blurred but read as given. Reading of "ætatis" and "colendus" is firm. Catchword "viva" at lower right, signature "H 2" at lower left.
